test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement required’.

Bring me the finest dress __from an finest__ shop.
solution:
The correct answer is: **from the finest**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Option 1 is correct because it uses the correct article ""the"" before ""finest"" to indicate a specific shop that is known to the speaker and the listener. Additionally, ""from"" is the appropriate preposition to use when indicating the source or origin of something.
 
• Option 2 is incorrect because it uses the incorrect adjective ""finer"" instead of ""finest."" ""Finer"" implies a comparison between two things, while ""finest"" indicates the highest quality or standard.
 
• Option 4 is incorrect because it uses the preposition ""through"" which does not make sense in this context. ""Through"" implies movement or passage, which is not relevant to the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **from the finest**.
